name: lipizzaner
label: Lipizzaner
tagline: Imperial, unhurried, and entirely aware of it.
description: Haute école for interfaces: Geist Serif set large over porcelain and midnight, imperial claret on light and champagne gold on dark, hairline cards and a spacious rhythm. Its horse, Maestoso, would like you to know he was bred for this.

horse.name: Maestoso
horse.line: Descended, he’ll remind you, from one of the six founding stallion lines of the Spanish Riding School.
voice: Spacing is not empty. It is room for me.
Gold on dark, naturally. Claret by day. I don’t do primary colours.

font.display: "Geist Serif", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
